_comment: Starter MCP pack for familia/code-bootstraps (Hermes HOSTS these). All OFF by default. This file is a reference/template; serve.sh/serve.ps1 load config/mcp-servers.json, NOT this file (see docs/starter-mcp-pack.md + TODO below). Every entry is version/sha-pinned, live-disableable, and routed through familia's approval gate (security-gating.json, #66). Enable a pick by copying it into config/mcp-servers.json and flipping enabled:true. Installs are download-to-named-file, never curl|sh.
_approval_gate: config/security-gating.json (#66): admin is ultimate authority; kill switch via state/disabled-models.json; fail-the-pick-not-the-swarm.

filesystem._desc: Read/write files, scoped to the project folder only.

git._desc: Local git operations (status, diff, log, commit). No network.

fetch._desc: Fetch a URL and return readable text. Web reading only.
fetch._later_option: Playwright MCP (browser automation) is a heavier future add; not in the starter set.

time._desc: Current time and timezone conversions. Lightweight; phone-safe.

memory._desc: Persistent knowledge-graph memory across sessions. Lightweight.

agent-reach._desc: familia's own Agent-Reach MCP (already shipped); promoted into the starter pack.

laya-guard._desc: Laya: 421M non-autoregressive jailbreak/tool-call decision guard. Screens input/output when wired as a guard.
laya-guard._install: docs/starter-mcp-pack.md (download-to-named-file; no model download this PR).
laya-guard._status: doc-TODO: no pinned MCP transport yet; integrate under #66 kill-switch model.

shannon-pentest._desc: Shannon: autonomous AI pentester (source analysis + exploit PoC), CI + SARIF 2.1.0. RISKY tier.
shannon-pentest._gating: security-gating.json tiers.risky: guard_gated, fail_closed_self_only, admin_override logged, banner. Start read-only/audit; exploitation is admin-gated and never default.
shannon-pentest._install: CLI `npx @keygraph/shannon@latest` or GitHub Action KeygraphHQ/shannon-action@v1. Point at staging only, never production.
shannon-pentest._status: doc-TODO: CI/Action wiring, not an always-on MCP server.

ligolo-ng._desc: Ligolo-ng: tunneling/pivoting tool (TUN interface). RISKY offensive-network tool.
ligolo-ng._gating: security-gating.json tiers.risky + scope.forbidden(network_scan_external, act). Admin-only, logged, banner. NOT an MCP server; included for lockdown/pivot tooling awareness.
ligolo-ng._status: doc-TODO: standalone CLI, not MCP; admin-gated, never default, preservative use only.

addons._comment: Add-ons: separate from core swarm roles. Extra MCPs, specialist/experimental models, opt-in tools, alternate interfaces. ALL off by default and live-disableable. Reference/template only.

hermes-desktop-webapp._desc: Browser-hosted Hermes Desktop (the real Desktop renderer served to a browser).
hermes-desktop-webapp._enable: hermes config set webapp.enabled true; hermes gateway restart; hermes webapp
hermes-desktop-webapp._note: Not the Web Dashboard. Loopback, one-use sign-in. No dedicated repo (hermes-desktop/hermes-agent-desktop are 404).

hermes-community-registry._desc: 'Add more' browser: community registry of MCPs/skills/agents.

specialist_models._comment: Specialist/experimental/security picks live in config/models-manifest.json (opt-in, pinned, never_default) and are gated by config/security-gating.json. Risky picks require a named-admin-signed sandbox spec (see docs/security-models.md).
